detail: search-api depends on results-cache, index-service and ranking-service; results-cache backfills its misses from index-service; index-service depends on search-db.

Results cache ready on 0.0.0.0:8080. build=results-cache/4.11.2 workers=8 store_pool=64 backfill_permits=32 single_flight=in-process ttl_default=900s. Rolling 5m hit ratio 94.1% over 41.2k lookups, lookup p95 6 ms.

Node results-cache-3 restarted during the scheduled maintenance window CHG-4471. Process came up with an empty keyspace: 0 of 2.41M keys resident, eviction of the warm working set complete, store pool reconnected in 812 ms.

AdmissionGate is shedding: 512 of 512 inflight permits held, wait queue depth 1.9k, oldest waiter 2.41s. Answering 6.8% of lookups with 429; observed miss rate 93.1% and every miss is opening a backfill of its own.

search.cache.readthrough.ReadThroughCache.get_or_backfill gave up after 2007 ms with no backfill permit. search.errors.BackfillSaturated: pool=index-backfill permits=32 inflight=32 queued=487 key=rq:v4:9f2c1b7e2a. 487 concurrent lookups collapsed onto 41 distinct keys, but the in-process single-flight registry held 0 entries, so each miss opened its own backfill instead of joining one. Traceback (most recent call last): File "search/api/results.py", line 88, in lookup_results | File "search/cache/readthrough.py", line 152, in get_or_backfill | File "search/runtime/pool.py", line 43, in acquire

Fan-out amplification in search.cache.readthrough: run_backfill re-entered ReadThroughCache.get_or_backfill for 118 keys that were still cold, doubling index-service traffic to 1.41k queries in 30s against a steady-state 210. Coalescing ratio 1.02 lookups per key — effectively none. StampedeGuard.should_coalesce returned False for every key because jitter_window_ms=0 in search.cache.policy.

Query admission saturated: 940 of 1024 queue slots occupied, 128 of 128 executor threads busy, oldest queued scan 3.21s. Inbound query rate 1.41k/min against a 30-day peak of 260/min — read amplification 6.4x. Answering new scans with SEARCH_QUEUE_FULL (503) on shard results_shard_2.

Slow-query monitor: 38 statements above the 250 ms threshold in the last minute, p95 480 ms (baseline 14 ms), 22 sessions queued behind the results_shard_2 index scan. Buffer cache hit rate down to 71%.

Downstream budget exceeded: results-cache lookups timed out at p95 2.2s against a 400 ms budget, and 31% of /search requests fell through to the index tier directly. Circuit breaker for results-cache is half-open, 14 of 20 probes failing.
GET /search returned HTTP 504 after the 8.0s gateway timeout to search-api. 22.6% of search sessions in the last minute ended on the error card; shoppers see 'search is taking longer than usual'.
Prewarm loop finished: 2.38M keys resident, rolling hit ratio restored to 91.4%, backfill permits down to 3 of 32 in use, lookup p95 back to 41 ms.
